lines: Slice one point five builds the design system's feedback, overlays and content, once.
Twenty-one components, each under its design-system name: alerts, toasts, dialogs, menus, cards, lists, tables, tabs and messages.
A danger alert is announced at once, with role alert. Good news waits politely, as a status.
The toast region keeps one polite live region, and an alert for each failure.
The dialog and drawer are shells for the CDK Dialog a screen will open.
The menu button moves with the arrow keys, Home and End, and Escape returns focus to its trigger.
Pagination and tabs are real links, marked with aria current, so Back and new tabs still work.
The table has a caption and column headers, and scrolls in its own region.
No screen uses them yet, so each is proven through the page: roles, names, focus and keys.
A hundred and forty tests pass. Each key rule was broken on purpose, and its test went red.
And nothing grew. Both apps start exactly as before, well inside their two hundred and seventy-five kilobyte budgets.
Next, slice one point six moves every built screen onto these components.
That's slice one point five. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
